Access.name: ricercaComparti
Access.Query:
SELECT DISTINCT f.codice_fondo, f.descr_fondo, f.classe, f.nome_fondo, f.isin, f.cod_soc_gest, f.tipologia, f.linea, f.divisa, f.prof_risch, f.orizz_temp, f.banca_dep, f.data_sott, f.data_chius, f.causale_chius, f.isin_fus, f.cons_azion, f.cons_obb, f.pic_progr, f.tipo_quota, f.blocco_operz, f.link_kii2, f.impo_min_sott, NVL(flag.flg_pic_progr_in_essere,'N') as flg_pic_progr_in_essere, saldi.posizul_i_numero_quote, saldi.QUOTAZ_I_VAL_MERCATO, saldi.ctv FROM cll.ana_fondi_mdv f JOIN cll.prof_fond_mdv prof ON (prof.codice_fondo = f.codice_fondo) JOIN cll.polfondi leg ON (leg.prod_c_fondo = cast(f.codice_fondo as char(11))) LEFT JOIN (SELECT round(NVL ( NVL(saldo.posizul_i_numero_quote, 0) * NVL(quota.QUOTAZ_I_VAL_MERCATO, 0), 0),3) ctv, saldo.posizul_i_numero_quote, quota.QUOTAZ_I_VAL_MERCATO, saldo.prod_c_fondo FROM cll.posizul saldo JOIN cll.v_quotaz quota on (trim(saldo.prod_c_fondo) = trim(quota.prodattfin_c)) WHERE quota.quotaz_c_div = 'EUR' AND saldo.contr_n = cast(
numeroContratto as char(20)) AND saldo.prod_c = cast(
codProdottoPolizza as char(11)) ) saldi ON (cast(f.codice_fondo as char(11)) = saldi.prod_c_fondo)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT pic.cod_isin, 'S' AS flg_pic_progr_in_essere FROM cll.legm_pic_fondo_mdv PIC JOIN cll.pic_progr_mdv dcpoliz ON (pic.contr_n = cast(dcpoliz.contr_n as char(20)) AND pic.prod_c = dcpoliz.prod_c ) WHERE 1=1 AND pic.contr_n = cast(
numeroContratto as char(20)) AND pic.prod_c = cast(
codProdottoPolizza as char(11)) AND pic.contr_n = DCPOLIZ.contr_n AND pic.prod_c = DCPOLIZ.prod_c AND dcpoliz.stato = '02' GROUP BY pic.contr_n, pic.prod_c, pic.cod_isin ) flag ON (flag.cod_isin = f.ISIN) WHERE 1 = 1 AND f.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND prof.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND leg.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S'
AND (UPPER(f.descr_fondo) LIKE UPPER(
%denominazione%) OR UPPER(f.isin) LIKE UPPER(
%denominazione%))
AND f.cod_soc_gest =
societa
AND f.tipologia =
tipologia
AND f.codice_fondo not in (fondiSelezionati)
AND f.data_sott <= sysdate AND f.data_chius >= sysdate AND f.blocco_operz in ('N','D')
AND prof.profilo = 'LIBERO' AND leg.prod_c_pol = cast(
codiceProdotto as char(11))
AND saldi.ctv is not null
AND saldi.ctv is null
order by f.descr_fondo

Access.name: numeroPolizzaAutocomplete
Access.Query:
SELECT DISTINCT leg.prod_c, prod.descr, contr.contr_n_poliz, contr.contr_n, leg.cli_c, leg.contrcli_c_ruolo_contr, contr.contr_d_emiss, cli.cli_m_cogn, cli.cli_m_nom, APV.COD_PIANO_VERSMT as formacontrle_c_forma_contrle, NVL(dettagliopolizze.flg_trasfor_pic,'N') as contrpolizvita_f_trasf_pic, saldo.ctv as CONTROVALORE, contr.contr_f_scudo_fiscale FROM cll.contr contr JOIN cll.contrcli leg ON (leg.contr_n = contr.contr_n AND leg.prod_c = contr.prod_c) JOIN cat_prod.dett_prod_tecn prod_tecn ON (prod_tecn.prod_c = leg.prod_c) JOIN cll.condversa polizza ON (polizza.contr_n = leg.contr_n AND polizza.prod_c = leg.prod_c) JOIN cll.dettagliopolizze dettagliopolizze ON (dettagliopolizze.contr_n = leg.contr_n AND dettagliopolizze.prod_c = leg.prod_c) JOIN cll.cli cli ON (cli.cli_c = leg.cli_c) JOIN cll.cliage cliage ON (cliage.cli_c = cli.cli_c) JOIN sogg_posizinform.dom_stato_contr st ON (trim(st.cod_stato_contr) = trim(contr.contr_c_stato)||trim(contr_c_motiv)) JOIN ( SELECT COD_CHIAV_NAT_PROD, DES_COMMRC_PROD as descr FROM CAT_PROD.ANAG_PROD_SERVZ WHERE gstd_f_esist = 'S' ) prod ON prod.COD_CHIAV_NAT_PROD = trim(leg.prod_c) join (select * from CAT_PROD.ANAG_POL_VITA where COD_CATEG_PROD_VITA = 'UL' and FLG_PIR = 'S') APV on (APV.COD_PROD_POL_VITA = leg.prod_c) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT round(NVL (sum( NVL(saldo.posizul_i_numero_quote, 0) * NVL(quota.QUOTAZ_I_VAL_MERCATO, 0) ), 0),3) ctv, saldo.prod_c, saldo.contr_n FROM cll.posizul saldo JOIN cll.contr contr ON (saldo.contr_n = contr.contr_n AND saldo.prod_c = contr.prod_c) JOIN cll.v_quotaz quota on (trim(saldo.prod_c_fondo) = trim(quota.prodattfin_c)) WHERE quota.quotaz_c_div = 'EUR' GROUP BY saldo.prod_c, saldo.contr_n, contr.contr_n_poliz ) saldo ON (saldo.prod_c = leg.prod_c AND saldo.contr_n = polizza.contr_n) WHERE cliage.cliage_d_fine = TO_DATE('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy') AND prod_tecn.cod_tipo_prod_contr = 'PV' AND leg.contrcli_c_ruolo_contr in (CAST('01' AS CHAR(3)),CAST('04' AS CHAR(3)),CAST('05' AS CHAR(3)),CAST('07' AS CHAR(3)),CAST('09' AS CHAR(3))) AND st.cod_tipo_prod_contr = 'PV' AND st.flg_contr_aper = 'A'
AND CLIAGE.AGE_C = LPAD(
codiceAgente, 10, '0')
AND leg.cli_c = LPAD(
ndgCliente,11,'0') AND contr.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND leg.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND polizza.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND dettagliopolizze.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S'
and contr.contr_n_poliz =cast(
numeroPolizza as char(20)) and leg.prod_c = cast(
codProdottoPolizza as char(11))
and contr.contr_n =cast(
numeroContratto as char(20))
and APV.COD_PIANO_VERSMT = 'PAC'
and (((dettagliopolizze.TIP_INVESTIMENTO = '1' OR (dettagliopolizze.TIP_INVESTIMENTO = '4' AND NVL(dettagliopolizze.FLG_TRASFOR_PIC,'N') = 'S')) AND dettagliopolizze.FLAG_PIC_PROGR = 'S') or (dettagliopolizze.TIP_INVESTIMENTO = '4' AND NVL(FLG_TRASFOR_PIC,'N') = 'N')) ORDER BY contr.contr_n_poliz

Access.name: loadTipologiaFondo
Access.Query: SELECT TIPOLOGIA_FONDO_COD,TIPOLOGIA_FONDO_DESCR FROM CEPE_TIPOLOGIA_FONDO order by TIPOLOGIA_FONDO_DESCR

Access.name: loadSicav
Access.Query:
SELECT DISTINCT cod_soc_gest as codice, cod_soc_gest as descrizione FROM cll.ana_fondi_mdv f JOIN cll.prof_fond_mdv prof ON (prof.codice_fondo = f.codice_fondo) JOIN cll.polfondi leg ON (leg.prod_c_fondo = cast(f.codice_fondo as char(11))) WHERE 1 = 1 AND f.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND prof.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND leg.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND f.data_sott <= sysdate AND f.data_chius >= sysdate AND f.blocco_operz in ('N','D') AND NVL(f.flg_partza_iis,'N') != 'S' AND prof.profilo = 'LIBERO' AND leg.prod_c_pol = cast(
codiceProdotto as char(11)) order by cod_soc_gest

Access.name: checkFondoBloccato
Access.Query:
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'S' END FROM cll.ana_fondi_mdv WHERE isin =
isin AND blocco_operz IN ('N','D') AND data_chius > sysdate AND data_sott <= sysdate AND gstd_f_esist = 'S'

Access.name: leggiControvalorePerLineaFondo
Access.Query: SELECT medbox.linea, round(NVL (sum( NVL(saldo.posizul_i_numero_quote, 0) * NVL(quota.QUOTAZ_I_VAL_MERCATO, 0) ), 0),3) FROM cll.posizul saldo JOIN cll.v_quotaz quota ON cast (quota.prodattfin_c as char(11)) = saldo.prod_c_fondo JOIN cll.ana_fondi_mdv medbox ON (CAST(medbox.codice_fondo AS CHAR(11))= saldo.prod_c_fondo) WHERE 1=1 AND saldo.contr_n = CAST(? AS CHAR(20)) AND saldo.prod_c = CAST(? AS CHAR(11)) AND quota.quotaz_c_div = 'EUR' AND saldo.gstd_f_esist = 'S' AND medbox.gstd_f_esist = 'S' GROUP BY medbox.linea

Access.name: checkDecumulo
Access.Query: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END FROM CLL.DETTAGLIOPOLIZZE WHERE GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND PROD_C = CAST(? AS CHAR(11)) AND CONTR_N = CAST(? AS CHAR(20)) AND FLAG_PIANO_DEC = 'D'

Access.name: checkConsolida
Access.Query: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END FROM CLL.DETTAGLIOPOLIZZE WHERE GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND PROD_C = CAST(? AS CHAR(11)) AND CONTR_N = CAST(? AS CHAR(20)) AND DETTAGLIOPOLIZZE_F_OPZIONE = 'C'

Access.name: recuperaAnagraficaProdottoFondo
Access.Query: SELECT COD_SURROG_PROD_SERVZ FROM CAT_PROD.VW_LEGM_APS_MIFID WHERE ISIN = rpad(?,15,' ') AND TIP_PROD = 'PV' AND CHIAVE_NAT_PADRE = ?

Access.name: recuperaDescrizioneProdotto
Access.Query: SELECT TRIM(prod_x_descr_prod) || ' ' || TRIM(prod_c_conv) FROM cll.prod WHERE prod_c = 'ULFAPIR'

Access.name: leggiFlagBloccoFondo
Access.Query: SELECT blocco_operz FROM ana_fondi_mdv WHERE isin = ?

Access.name: leggiDatiPianoPac
Access.Query: SELECT case when pag.modpg_i_rata is not null then pag.modpg_i_rata else case when cve.condversa_i_versa != 0 then cve.condversa_i_versa else c.contr_i_bonus / cve.condversa_n_peridc_versa end end AS importo_rata, to_char(cve.condversa_n_peridc_versa) AS numero_rate_anno, pag.modpg_n_cc as conto FROM condversa cve INNER JOIN dettagliopolizze poliz ON poliz.contr_n = cve.contr_n AND poliz.prod_c = cve.prod_c INNER JOIN contr c on c.contr_n = cve.contr_n AND c.prod_c = cve.prod_c LEFT JOIN modpg pag ON pag.contr_n = cve.contr_n AND pag.prod_c = cve.prod_c AND pag.gstd_f_esist = 'S' WHERE poliz.gstd_f_esist = 'S' AND cve.gstd_f_esist = 'S' AND CONDVERSA_C_TIP_VERSA = '004' AND cve.condversa_n_peridc_versa > 0 AND c.CONTR_I_BONUS is not null AND c.CONTR_I_BONUS > 0 AND cve.condversa_n_versa > 0 AND (poliz.FLG_TRASFOR_PIC = 'N' or poliz.FLG_TRASFOR_PIC is null) AND cve.prod_c = CAST(? AS CHAR(11)) AND cve.contr_n = CAST(? AS CHAR(20))

Access.name: hasSddAttivi
Access.Query: SELECT case when count(*) = 0 then 'N' else 'S' end as hasSddAttivi FROM cll.modpg mp JOIN cll.contr cn ON mp.contr_n = cn.contr_n AND mp.prod_c = cn.prod_c WHERE mp.gstd_f_esist = 'S' AND cn.gstd_f_esist = 'S' AND (mp.modpg_d_revoca_rid > TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE)+1 OR MODPG_D_REVOCA_RID = to_date('17530101','YYYYMMDD')) AND cn.prod_c = CAST('ULFAPIR' AS CHAR(11)) AND cn.contr_n = CAST(? AS CHAR(20))

Access.name: hasSddSospesi
Access.Query: SELECT case when count(*) = 0 then 'N' else 'S' end as hasSddSospesi FROM cll.modpg mp JOIN cll.contr cn ON mp.contr_n = cn.contr_n AND mp.prod_c = cn.prod_c WHERE mp.gstd_f_esist = 'S' AND cn.gstd_f_esist = 'S' AND mp.modpg_s_rid = '2' AND cn.prod_c = CAST('ULFAPIR' AS CHAR(11)) AND cn.contr_n = CAST(? AS CHAR(20))

Access.name: isSddAttivoBancaEsterna
Access.Query: SELECT case when mp.anabanca_c_abi = '03062' then 'N' else 'S' end as isSddAttivoBancaEsterna FROM cll.modpg mp JOIN cll.contr cn ON mp.contr_n = cn.contr_n AND mp.prod_c = cn.prod_c WHERE mp.gstd_f_esist = 'S' AND cn.gstd_f_esist = 'S' AND (mp.modpg_d_revoca_rid > TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE)+1 OR MODPG_D_REVOCA_RID = to_date('17530101','YYYYMMDD')) AND cn.prod_c = CAST('ULFAPIR' AS CHAR(11)) AND cn.contr_n = CAST(? AS CHAR(20))

Access.name: loadDatiAltroCliente
Access.Query: select COD_CLI_POTENZ, trim(CLI_M_COGN) || ' ' || trim(CLI_M_NOM) from CLL.CLI where CLI_C = substr('00000000000' || ?, -11) and GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S'

Access.name: gradoRischioResidenzaFisica
Access.Query: select distinct pae.COD_RISCH_RICLAGG AS gradoRischioResidenzaFisica from cll.v_indcli cli inner join utly.dom_naz naz on cli.NAZ_C_NAZ = naz.COD_NAZ_CLI inner join cll.paestero pae on naz.cod_naz_uic_cdcri = pae.paestero_c_uic where naz.gstd_f_esist = 'S' and pae.gstd_f_esist = 'S' and cli.TIPIND_C_TIP_IND = '01' and sysdate between naz.DAT_INIZ_VALID and naz.DAT_FINE_VALID and cli.CLI_C = ?

Access.name: gradoRischioResidenzaFisicaProspect
Access.Query: select distinct pae.COD_RISCH_RICLAGG AS gradoRischioResidenzaFisicaProspect from cll.INR_INDCLI_ELETTR_REP cli inner join utly.dom_naz naz on cli.NAZ_C_NAZ = naz.COD_NAZ_CLI inner join cll.paestero pae on naz.cod_naz_uic_cdcri = pae.paestero_c_uic WHERE naz.gstd_f_esist = 'S' and pae.gstd_f_esist = 'S' and cli.TIPIND_C_TIP_IND = '01' and sysdate between naz.DAT_INIZ_VALID and naz.DAT_FINE_VALID AND cli.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE = ?
